_about: Magic items whose actions askdnd shows on Battle (app/conditions.py). Our own short summaries of the 2024 rules, never book text. starts / ends: a condition the action gives or ends (shown as a pill on Battle).

Ring of Invisibility.name: Turn Invisible
Ring of Invisibility.text: Take a Magic action to give yourself the Invisible condition. It lasts until you take the ring off or take a Bonus Action to become visible. Unlike the Invisibility spell, attacking or casting a spell doesn't end it.

Ring of Invisibility.name: Become visible
Ring of Invisibility.text: Take a Bonus Action to end the Invisible condition the ring gave you.
